correctness.rationale: For binary diagonal alpha,beta_i,gamma, the idempotence equations force (alpha+beta_i-1)x_i=(beta_i+gamma-1)y_i=0 and (alpha+gamma-1)z+sum_i x_iy_i=0. The only nontrivial entry of (a-e)^2 is sum_i(p_i-x_i)(s_i-y_i). Unequal endpoints give affine rank-zero/nonzero fibers q^(r+1) or q^r; equal endpoints reduce to a t-dimensional finite-field dot-product with zero count q^(2t-1)+q^t-q^(t-1) (and nonzero count q^(2t-1)-q^(t-1)). Maximization at t=r gives q^(2r-1)+q^r-q^(r-1), versus ordinary q^(2r). Independent literal incidence-product enumeration for q=2,3 and r<=3 confirms the formulas; universal statement follows from exact algebra, including characteristic 2.
residual_risks: The independent enumerator covers finite small cases, not all q,r; universal proof relies on explicit incidence equations.
